    How the bot works

    One message in. Answer back in seconds.

    Every Botgo bot runs the same simple loop on every platform — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Messenger, Instagram and AI chatbots alike. Your message travels from your phone to the bot on its server and straight back again, and that little round trip is why replies feel instant everywhere.

    Your Phone WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and more — you just type a command
    your command
    Botgo Bot Reads the command and does the work
    runs it
    Server · 24/7 Hosted and always online — even while you sleep
    The reply rides back
    usually in a second or two

    WhatsApp

    Where: groups, your private “You” self chat and customer chats You send: .menu, .tagall — or a plain question Bot does: welcomes members, deletes spam links, posts group status and takes orders

    Telegram

    Where: private chats, groups and channels You send: /start — or just tap the inline buttons Bot does: opens menus, welcomes new members, guards the group and posts to your channel

    Discord

    Where: servers and channels like #general and #welcome You send: slash commands like /menu and /announce Bot does: moderates the chat, removes bad links, welcomes joiners and posts announcements

    Messenger & Instagram

    Where: your Facebook Page inbox and Instagram DMs You send: a normal message — or tap “Get started” Bot does: answers FAQs, shows products and prices, and takes orders while you sleep

    AI Chatbots

    Where: your website, WhatsApp and any chat window You send: plain questions, in normal words Bot does: answers from your own business info — hours, prices, delivery — 24/7

    Custom & Order Bots

    Where: wherever your work happens — shops, bookings, teams You send: orders, bookings and updates, step by step Bot does: collects every detail in order and notifies you the moment it lands

    How it works

    From idea to launch, step by step.

    Every project — bot or website — follows the same clear path, so you always know what happens next.

    1

    Idea

    You describe what you want in a short message — a rough idea is enough to start.

    2

    Planning

    We agree the features, the platform and the timeline, with a fixed quote before any work begins.

    3

    Build

    Your bot or website is built to the plan, with progress updates along the way.

    4

    Test

    Everything is tested properly — commands, flows, pages and mobile view — before you see it as final.

    5

    Launch

    Your project goes live, connected and ready for real users and customers.

    6

    Support

    After delivery you still have support — fixes, guidance and new features when you need them.

    Pricing

    Honest pricing, based on your project.

    There is no fixed price list, because no two bots or websites are the same. Your quote depends on what is actually being built:

    • The platform and the features you need
    • How many flows, pages or commands are involved
    • Design and content requirements
    • Any integrations with other tools or services

    You receive the full quote before work starts — no surprises added later.
